description: List the supplement categories that currently hold priced products, each with a live product count, store count, lowest normalized unit price, and its comparison basis (per_kg / per_serving / per_capsule). Use this to discover a valid category_slug for find_cheapest.

market.description: Optional country market to query: nl, be, fr, gb, pl, es. Defaults to nl, the market this endpoint answers for. Any other value is rejected.

name: list_categories
title: List categories
